annotations.text: Proposed art pass for Crown Rush. Nothing here is built yet: the map, terrain, raiders and buildings are the plan. Tell me what to change and I will implement it in the game.
Gameplay effect of rivers: raiders funnel over the two bridges, so a tower by each bridge earns its keep. If you would rather keep the map open, I can make rivers shallow fords instead.
Raider stats stay as they are; only the models change. The Elite's glowing visor and the Giant's horns are the two new signature details.
Buildings keep their current footprints so no pad positions move. Wall materials read in silhouette: pointed pickets, flat brick, rounded stone, spiked iron.
